Good morning. This synthetic call is for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. Statements regarding future performance are
forward-looking and involve risks and uncertainties. All figures discussed are fictional and intended for the FinSight AI training
corpus.
Elena Marlowe, Chief Executive Officer
We generated $1.31 billion of revenue and $0.30 billion of net income in the second quarter. Loan growth was broad-based,
deposit retention remained strong, and the net interest margin improved to 3.51%. We remain attentive to office-related
commercial real estate, but criticized assets are stable and remain manageable. Digital engagement continues to improve, and
our AI-assisted service tools reduced average handling time by 11%.
David Chen, Chief Financial Officer
Compared with the prior-year quarter, revenue increased primarily from higher loan balances and fee income. Expense growth
was contained despite elevated technology investment. Provision expense was $80 million, and the allowance coverage ratio
improved modestly. Capital remained strong at 12.6% CET1. For the full year, we continue to target net interest income growth
of 5% to 7% and an efficiency ratio below 55%.
Analyst Q&A;
Analyst 1: How are you thinking about commercial real estate risk?
CEO: We are most cautious in office properties outside the strongest central business districts.
We have increased monitoring frequency and stress-tested collateral values. Our current loss
assumptions remain below the levels that would require a major change to capital planning.
Analyst 2: What is driving the margin improvement?
CFO: The improvement reflects loan repricing and a modestly better deposit mix. We are not
assuming the pace continues indefinitely because funding costs remain sensitive to market
rates.
Analyst 3: Where is AI creating measurable value?
CEO: The clearest near-term value is internal productivity. Document summarization,
service-ticket triage, and coding assistance have reduced manual work. We are cautious about
customer-facing recommendations and require human oversight for material decisions.
Closing Remarks
The company reiterated full-year 2026 net interest income growth of 5% to 7% and efficiency ratio below 55%, subject to market
and execution conditions. Management emphasized disciplined capital allocation, technology modernization, and risk
management.
End of transcript
